staticSize.description: Number of endpoints in the static registry

dynamicSize.description: Number of endpoints in the dynamic registry

maximumCacheSize.description: Maximum number of entries to store in the dynamic registry

stub.description: Whether the endpoint is a stub endpoint

direction.description: Whether the endpoint is used as input or output (in or out) (only present when runtime endpoint registry statistics are available)

hits.description: Usage of the endpoint (only present when runtime endpoint registry statistics are available)

routeId.description: The route ID (only present when runtime endpoint registry statistics are available and the endpoint is associated with a route)

minBodySize.description: Minimum message body size in bytes (only present when available)

maxBodySize.description: Maximum message body size in bytes (only present when available)

meanBodySize.description: Mean message body size in bytes (only present when available)

minHeadersSize.description: Minimum message headers size in bytes (only present when available)

maxHeadersSize.description: Maximum message headers size in bytes (only present when available)

meanHeadersSize.description: Mean message headers size in bytes (only present when available)
